title: commonprosperity
description: Would you be willing to share your levels with players who need them more?
body: Very often, you play games with your good friends and tackle certain levels together. However, personal circumstances can frequently lead to a huge gap in your experience levels, which may cause some troubles. To address this issue, the mod has added an optimization mechanism: it evenly distributes all the experience gained by the group to the players with the lowest levels, narrowing the level gap among all participants and thus promoting harmonious gameplay and common progress.
